summary: Current main 142ad75c433692d8ffaf80585d6bb66a553c9cd2 still reproduces the canonical Chinese-recall defect: the existing English/Spanish-only matcher returns false for both reported Chinese recall prompts, so the active-memory hook returns before calling the deep-recall path when lane one has no strong hit. The required repair is narrow and now includes a plugin-boundary integration regression, but this checkout is read-only and lacks node_modules, preventing edits and test execution.

actions.reason: The report is a reproducible, plugin-owned default-path behavior defect with a clear canonical implementation path and no hydrated candidate PR.
The expanded repair contract requires matcher, unit, and hook-boundary coverage so the issue cannot regress as a detector-only test pass.
A writable trusted repair checkout with prepared dependencies is required to implement and validate the narrowed three-file fix.
